note: Fold matches are candidates, not confirmed spelling errors.
method: Manually selected domain phrases and words; exact token boundaries; mixed accented/unaccented syllables allowed in phrases; reviewed partial accent forms and explicit field-value context. Candidate inventory is not an exhaustive semantic classification of spelling errors.
source_record_definition: CSV record position including header (first data row=2), not physical line number.
preview_scope: Only accent restoration; does not rerun teencode or VNCoreNLP. Existing cleaned_comment in source is not updated.
